definitions.explanation: A team game in which players throw a ball to hit opponents, who are out when struck. A fixture of Japanese elementary-school PE classes and recess.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昼休|ひるやす}み→昼休み：01715_hiruyasumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ドッジボール⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We played dodgeball during the lunch break.

examples.japanese: ドッジボール⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ボール→ボール：00017_booru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{当|あ}てられて→当てる：01864_ateru⟧⟦{外野|がいや}→外野：09266_gaiya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: I got hit by the ball in dodgeball and had to go to the outfield.

examples.japanese: ⟦{体育|たいいく}→体育：03384_taiiku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦クラス→クラス：01084_kurasu⟧⟦{対抗|たいこう}→対抗：12398_taikou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ドッジボール⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{残|のこ}った→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: There was an inter-class dodgeball tournament during PE, and I survived until the end.

notes:
Also written ドッチボール in casual writing. In the Japanese school version, players who are hit move to the ⟦{外野|がいや}→外野：09266_gaiya⟧ (outfield) surrounding the opposing court and can return by hitting someone from there.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ドッジボール⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to play dodgeball
- ドッジボール⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧: a dodgeball tournament
- ⟦ボール→ボール：00017_booru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{当|あ}てる→当てる：01864_ateru⟧: to hit someone with the ball
- ⟦ボール→ボール：00017_booru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|よ}ける→避ける：14848_yokeru⟧: to dodge the ball

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{球技|きゅうぎ}→球技：09279_kyuugi⟧: ball games — the category term used in PE
- ドッジ{弾平|だんぺい}: a famous dodgeball manga that popularized the sport
